You are a careful research coder. Do the work yourself: spawn no agents, run nothing in the background, fetch no web pages, use no scripts or keyword rules to assign codes (a helper script only to serialize your hand-assigned codes is fine, kept in your private directory /private/tmp/layers-01-c1/).

BASE = "BASE"
Read BASE/codebook-deploy-layers.md and the pages in BASE/data/batches/layers-01.json (each has id and text, a text snapshot of a vendor case page). Open no other file under BASE: in particular nothing in BASE/data/coded/, no other batch and no other codebook. Code every page by hand from its text, read in full (a long page may be cut in your file view: re-read that part until you have the whole text). Write BASE/data/coded/layers-01-c1.jsonl with exactly one JSON object per line per page, in input order, in the output format the codebook specifies, ids copied exactly. Write no other file under BASE. Return only: the number of pages coded, the number with live_agent yes, and the number of entries per party_kind.
